title: Friday, 6:50 a.m.
intro: The Mayor's house. Everything is tidy, in the way of people who have run out of things they are allowed to change.

items.label: Red ribbon on the doorknob
items.text: A red ribbon on the doorknob of the Mayor's bedroom. Nobody has a key to the Mayor's house except the Playhouse, and the Mayor is the Playhouse's landlord. You decide not to think about it before coffee.

items.label: Mirror
items.text: A competent, tired face that has been in a lot of photographs. Pruned fingertips. You decide to wear gloves to the meeting.

items.label: Gavel (basset hound)
items.text: Gavel howls once, long and low, and lies down across your feet. You are not going anywhere. He is a very warm paperweight with opinions.

items.label: Green hymnal on the shelf
items.text: A green hymnal, not the Chapel's. Between the pages of Hymn 211 and 213, a folded list of names on very old paper. Two hundred and twelve. Some have a tick. One is crossed out hard: PRUITT, H.

items.label: Phone
items.text: Three voicemails from Harlan, your father, all the same: 'I signed the sheet, Del. I signed it.' The third one is just breathing.

items.label: Letter of resignation (copy)
items.text: 'Dear Council, effective the day after Founders' Day...' A copy. The original is already in the post. You can't take it back. That's the point.

items.label: Speech draft, v3
items.text: 'Neighbors, there is something to report.' Underlined. In the margin, in your own hand: 'Say it before you lose the nerve.'

items.label: Vault key on a ribbon
items.text: A brass key on a very old ribbon. The Town Hall vault. It opens at the same time every evening, if you have the key and no better idea.

items.label: Four generations of Pruitts
items.text: Edmund, Harlan, you, June. Every one of you stands in front of the lake. None of you is smiling. Hattie is not in the photo. There is a gap where a fifth frame hung.

items.label: Mug: World's Okayest Mayor
items.text: Your daughter gave it to you. It's the most honest thing anyone has ever said about this office.

items.label: Fern with strong opinions
items.text: It has been dying with dignity since 2019. You water it. It resents it.
